serif.description: Serif fonts have small strokes at letter ends; they read as classic, literary, editorial, and trustworthy. Best for quotes that feel timeless, profound, or luxurious.

fonts.name: Cormorant Garamond
fonts.description: High-contrast Garamond-inspired serif with very thin hairlines and tall, refined letterforms. Feels literary, luxurious, and expensive.
fonts.use_cases: Luxury/fashion quote posts, romantic literary moods, editorial headlines. Use at large sizes (28px+); shine at xlarge.
fonts.avoid_cases: Small text, casual/energetic moods, low-contrast busy backgrounds.

fonts.name: Playfair Display
fonts.description: High-contrast Didone serif with dramatic thick-to-thin stroke transitions and elegant sharp serifs. Bold, luxurious, fashion-editorial.
fonts.use_cases: Fashion/luxury headlines, bold statement posts, magazine-style overlays. Use at large sizes.
fonts.avoid_cases: Small text, dense paragraphs, casual or playful moods.

fonts.name: DM Serif Display
fonts.description: Confident display serif with strong contrast and crisp, sturdy serifs. Modern-editorial rather than antique: it commands attention without feeling old-fashioned.
fonts.use_cases: Headline-style quotes, bold statement posts, lifestyle and modern-luxury brands.
fonts.avoid_cases: Small text, formal/traditional ceremonies, dense body copy.

fonts.name: Libre Baskerville
fonts.description: Transitional serif based on Baskerville, optimized for screens: solid, evenly-weighted strokes with a warm, bookish authority. Very readable at medium sizes.
fonts.use_cases: Longer quotes, classic literature/philosophy, education content, dark-bottom overlays.
fonts.avoid_cases: Delicate/airy layouts, playful or youthful moods.

fonts.name: Lora
fonts.description: Well-rounded serif with calligraphic brush-like curves and moderate contrast. Warm and approachable; bridges traditional and modern without shouting.
fonts.use_cases: Personal/reflective quotes, wellness and mindfulness content, storytelling posts.
fonts.avoid_cases: Tech/futuristic themes, loud statement headlines.

fonts.name: Crimson Text
fonts.description: Old-style serif modeled on classic book typography: compact, dense, and highly legible. Feels like a trusted printed page.
fonts.use_cases: Longer quotes, narrative/storytelling content, classic literary moods.
fonts.avoid_cases: Bold modern headlines, casual/social-media energy.

fonts.name: EB Garamond
fonts.description: Authentic Renaissance-era Garamond revival with genuinely historical letterforms and fine, even strokes. Reads like a 16th-century manuscript.
fonts.use_cases: Classical quotes, heritage/tradition themes, academic and intellectual content.
fonts.avoid_cases: Modern/tech vibes, short punchy social posts.

fonts.name: Spectral
fonts.description: Contemporary transitional serif designed by Production Type for screen-first long-form reading, rooted in French Elzevir tradition. Crisp, scholarly, and effortlessly elegant at any size.
fonts.use_cases: Academic/intellectual quotes, editorial/magazine style, longer text that must stay readable.
fonts.avoid_cases: Casual/fun content, loud display headlines.

sans-serif.description: Sans-serif fonts have no end strokes; they read as modern, clean, neutral, and trustworthy. Best for contemporary, minimalist, or tech-adjacent quotes.

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.description: Ultra-neutral sans designed for screen readability with a tall x-height and balanced proportions. Almost invisible typography — lets the quote itself speak.
fonts.use_cases: Minimalist designs, dark backgrounds, longer quotes needing clarity, data/analytics themes.
fonts.avoid_cases: Warm/organic moods, decorative or expressive headlines.

fonts.name: Montserrat
fonts.description: Geometric sans inspired by 1920s Buenos Aires signage: clean circular letterforms with a confident, slightly retro-modern feel. Versatile and friendly.
fonts.use_cases: Modern editorial quotes, brand-style posts, motivational content, urban/lifestyle themes.
fonts.avoid_cases: Formal/literary moods, delicate romantic layouts.

fonts.name: Poppins
fonts.description: Geometric sans built on circles: rounded terminals and even curves give it a soft, friendly, modern energy. Stands out without being loud.
fonts.use_cases: Lifestyle/wellness quotes, youthful and positive content, playful-but-clean layouts.
fonts.avoid_cases: Traditional/academic themes, serious or somber moods.

fonts.name: Raleway
fonts.description: Elegant, high-contrast sans inspired by Art Deco signage; thin weights feel luxurious and refined while bolder weights turn editorial.
fonts.use_cases: Fashion/luxury quotes, elegant minimalist layouts, sophisticated brand posts.
fonts.avoid_cases: Casual/fun content, dense paragraphs.

fonts.name: Work Sans
fonts.description: Humanist grotesque designed for screen clarity: warm, open, and unobtrusive with excellent legibility even in longer blocks.
fonts.use_cases: Longer quotes needing readability, education/how-to content, productivity and focus themes.
fonts.avoid_cases: Bold display headlines, decorative or expressive posts.

monospace.description: Monospace fonts give every character equal width; they read as technical, precise, and retro-futuristic. Best for quotes about code, technology, or minimal data-driven moods.

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.description: Modern monospace designed for code reading: tall x-height, clear distinguishable glyphs, slight square feel. Precise and developer-native.
fonts.use_cases: Tech/coding quotes, developer humor, data/analytics themes, terminal aesthetic.
fonts.avoid_cases: Warm/organic content, romantic or luxury moods.

fonts.name: IBM Plex Mono
fonts.description: Refined corporate monospace from IBM's design language: even color, slightly condensed, professional and calm. Feels engineered and trustworthy.
fonts.use_cases: Technical/enterprise quotes, clean minimalist tech posts, code-adjacent content.
fonts.avoid_cases: Casual/playful content, expressive headlines.

fonts.name: Space Mono
fonts.description: Bold, wide monospace with square dots over the i/j and angular cut terminals; a distinctive retro-futuristic vibe. Memorable and slightly quirky.
fonts.use_cases: Futuristic/sci-fi themed quotes, bold display text, edgy tech posts.
fonts.avoid_cases: Small text, formal or delicate layouts.

handwritten.description: Handwritten/script fonts mimic handwriting or calligraphy; they read as personal, human, warm, and emotional. Best for short quotes where feeling matters more than formality.

fonts.name: Great Vibes
fonts.description: High-contrast formal calligraphy script with dramatic swooping flourishes and elegant connecting strokes. Reads as premium, refined, and celebratory.
fonts.use_cases: Elegant/wedding-style quotes, luxury brand content, short romantic lines. Keep it short.
fonts.avoid_cases: Long text (legibility drops fast), bold/casual layouts, body copy.

fonts.name: Allura
fonts.description: Casual handwriting script with simple, clean, very legible letterforms and soft formal curves. Elegant but more relaxed than Great Vibes — intimate rather than ceremonial.
fonts.use_cases: Love/relationship quotes, feminine/delicate layouts, greeting-card moods, package-style branding.
fonts.avoid_cases: Tech or masculine themes, long passages, dense layouts.

fonts.name: Parisienne
fonts.description: Casual connecting script inspired by 1960s design: slight bounce and graceful, romantic strokes with ornate flourished uppercase. Playful yet elegant — French-chic.
fonts.use_cases: Fashion/beauty quotes, boutique and bakery branding, wedding invites, quote graphics.
fonts.avoid_cases: Tech/casual-loud themes, long sentences, small sizes.

fonts.name: Sacramento
fonts.description: Monoline semi-connected script inspired by 1950s-60s hand-lettered brochures: uniform stroke width, tall and airy. Sits between formal and casual with real headline presence.
fonts.use_cases: Minimalist elegant quotes, fashion/lifestyle posts, retro-vintage moods, short titles.
fonts.avoid_cases: Bold/loud layouts, very small text.

fonts.name: Caveat
fonts.description: Casual, natural handwriting with a variable baseline like a marker note — letters dip and rise. Friendly, personal, and informal.
fonts.use_cases: Personal/reflective quotes, lifestyle and wellness content, handwritten-note aesthetics.
fonts.avoid_cases: Tech/formal themes, long paragraphs, luxury moods.

fonts.name: Dancing Script
fonts.description: Casual connected script with bouncy letterforms and moderate contrast — joyful and celebratory, like animated handwriting.
fonts.use_cases: Inspirational quotes, celebration/event content, warm positive posts.
fonts.avoid_cases: Long text, tech/formal themes, somber subjects.

fonts.name: Pacifico
fonts.description: Retro 1950s-60s rounded script with bold, friendly, chunky curves — evokes surf and soda-shop signage. Fun, warm, and approachable.
fonts.use_cases: Casual/fun quotes, food/travel content, summery and retro moods.
fonts.avoid_cases: Formal/professional themes, luxury or somber posts.

display.description: Display fonts are loud, high-impact faces made for headlines and short statements. Best for punchy one-liners that must grab attention immediately.

fonts.name: Anton
fonts.description: Ultra-bold condensed sans with very tall, narrow, heavy letterforms. Loud, blocky, and impossible to ignore — pure poster impact.
fonts.use_cases: Short punchy quotes, sports/motivation posts, bold statement headlines.
fonts.avoid_cases: Long text, elegant/refined layouts, anything needing subtlety.

fonts.name: Bebas Neue
fonts.description: Tall, thin-stroked condensed sans designed for all-caps display: narrow uppercase letters with a clean poster/editorial feel. Striking and memorable.
fonts.use_cases: Short all-caps quotes, one-liner headlines, fashion/urban posters.
fonts.avoid_cases: Lowercase-heavy text, long paragraphs, romantic moods.

fonts.name: Abril Fatface
fonts.description: Extremely high-contrast Didone display serif inspired by 19th-century advertising posters: heavy blacks with hairline serifs and clean curves. Dramatic and elegant at once.
fonts.use_cases: Headline quotes, fashion/luxury statements, posters and packaging where type is the star.
fonts.avoid_cases: Small text, dense paragraphs, casual moods.

fonts.name: Oswald
fonts.description: Tall condensed grotesque sans inspired by classic gothic letterforms (Alternate Gothic lineage). Compact, strong, and authoritative.
fonts.use_cases: Headline quotes, sports/motivation, bold statement posts, newspaper-style headlines.
fonts.avoid_cases: Elegant/refined layouts, long readable paragraphs.
